why: The two zig-zag arrows lose one zig each step (4, 3, 2), so next they have no zig at all: straight arrows that still point towards the long arrow (down-right and up-right). That is option 2. Option 3 has straight arrows but they point the wrong way, and options 1 and 4 still have 2 zigs.
trick: If something shrinks step by step, the next figure is the simplest form that keeps the same direction.
